title: Categories section
description: Three rows of category chips that scroll without end, the middle one the other way. A row stops under the pointer, and the chip’s icon plays.

fragments.title: Define the element
fragments.note: Built-in triggers only. The rest of the script is one call that scrolls the rows.

fragments.title: A row of chips
fragments.note: target points the icon at its chip, so the whole chip is the hover area. The track holds the set three times; the copies are hidden from screen readers and the Tab key.

fragments.title: Slide by one set, then start over
fragments.note: --progress from 0 to 1 moves the track by one set. Only transform changes, so nothing is repainted.

fragments.title: Slow to a stop, then pick up
fragments.note: One loop moves every row at its own rate. The rate eases to 0 under the pointer or keyboard focus, and back to 1 after.

fragments.title: Chip colours
fragments.note: One custom property per chip. Hover mixes it with black.
